name: Gay Nineties Revival
summary: Driven by a nostalgic pushback against sterile and cold mid-century modernism, the architectural revival exploded across American themed restaurants, interior design, and pop culture, diffusing authentic distinct psychedelic-era twists and Gilded Age elements.
